PHASE.NAME: GraphRAG And MCP Robustness
PHASE.GOAL: Resolve FIX/M4 and FIX/L5 by caching expensive graph builds and bounding MCP JSON-RPC message input.

DATA_FLOWS.FLOW: MCP GraphRAG calls read a cached CodeGraph for the current root and invalidate/rebuild only when indexing state changes.
MCP stdio reads reject oversized JSON-RPC messages before allocating unbounded buffers.

STEPS.step-1: Made CodeGraph clone cheap with Arc-backed inner storage.
STEPS.step-2: Added graph cache key storage, root/index validation, and invalidation surface in SynapseHandler.
STEPS.step-3: Coordinated index rebuilds with GraphBuilder cache invalidation and root/index metadata cache keys.
STEPS.step-4: Replaced unbounded stdin lines reading with a bounded JSON-RPC line reader.
